executive_summary: On May 2, 2026, OFAC added 28 new entities to the SDN list, primarily targeting individuals and companies involved in Iranian sanctions evasion. The additions include entities from China, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates. The designations are part of the IRAN-EO13846 and IRAN-EO13902 programs, highlighting the ongoing efforts to disrupt Iranian illicit activities. The majority of the added entities are linked to Iran's petroleum and petrochemical industries, as well as exchange houses and trading companies.
